infobox.usage: Unlocks two cash register booths on the first floor of the Tarbank on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Tarbank cash register department key (Tarbank) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: An access key to the cash registers of the regional branch of Tarbank.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Cash register booths on the first floor of the Tarbank on Streets of Tarkov

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Bank cash register in each booth
- 1x Bank safe in each booth
